mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park, a full moon, and an International Space Station pass tonight that unfortunately won't be visible due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain.

City officials announced that a segment of Highway M will be closed from October 5 through October 7 to accommodate final road work for the new Aldi site, with traffic detours routed through Old PB and East Verona Avenue.
There is plenty to do, including live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and a variety of trivia nights starting Tuesday.
In a notable call for service on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired, leading to the arrest of a 19-year-old suspect.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the rich and classic Turtle; the restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
